# Full-suite verification and audit readiness

Final verification slice for the parent item: confirm the complete change set is
green and the acceptance criteria are demonstrably met before the parent advances to
`in_review`. Runs the full project test suite and build at the final commit, then
records the evidence.

Covers parent AC8.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Parent AC traceability: Full suite green. Full project test suite must pass with the new changes (unit tests as the minimum during implementation; the full suite run before review).

- `npm run build` succeeds (TypeScript strict compile + Vite bundle) at the final commit.
- The full test suite passes at the final commit (via `/skill:test`, quiet mode,
   triaged), populating the read-only test cache so a subsequent audit can consume it.
- Every parent acceptance criterion (AC1-AC8) is mapped to a passing test or a
   verified assertion; the mapping is recorded in a comment on the parent item.
- The parent's tutorial browser suite and the Main Street unit suite pass with no
   stale-geometry warnings.
- No regressions in adjacent Main Street behaviour (deferred end-of-turn HUD window,
   action economy, community-favour engine/persistence) — the relevant suites pass.
- The change set is committed with a work-item-associated message and the commit hash
   is recorded on the parent item; no uncommitted changes remain in the worktree.

## Minimal Implementation

- Run `npm run build`.
- Run the full suite via `/skill:test` (quiet, triaged) at the final commit.
- Record the AC-to-test mapping and the green-run evidence as a comment on the parent.
- Record the commit hash(es) on the parent item.

## Key Files

- `package.json` (scripts reference only)
- `tests/main-street/` (verification surface)

## Dependencies

- Relocate favour buttons into HUD with tooltips.
- Action counter above End Turn (all phases).
- Tutorial highlights follow moved UI.
- Documentation update.
